identity.symptom: explicit request mapping rejected for annotated service route options

what: Annotated ServiceRouteOptions falsely reject a valid explicit path mapping.
expected: An explicit mapping from the filename id to the function value input passes both route contracts and compiler checks.
observed: The actual relkit check subprocess exits 1 with TS2344 and RELKIT_ROUTE_MODULE_TYPE; the corresponding type regression also fails.
root_cause: packages/routes/src/define-service-routes.types.ts:45-49 requires a request property while ServiceRouteOptions declares it optional, dropping its request mapping type to undefined.
fixed_by: Infer EntryRequest from the public optional request property and include undefined in the constraint, preserving explicitly undefined requests. Focused type, installed declaration, editor, CLI graph/activation and failure-preservation regressions pass.

invariants: An explicit mapping from the filename id to the function value input passes both route contracts and compiler checks.
Invalid actual route exports and undeclared inferred path inputs still prevent activation.
